method: Each page rendered with Poppler pdftoppm at 100 dpi in 8-bit grey; the body pixels, excluding a 60 pt band at the top and at the bottom of each page (running header and page number), compared by SHA-256. A page counts as unchanged only if its body pixels are identical at that resolution. Earlier records compared pdftotext word boxes; those boxes shift on every page here because the new glyphs change the embedded font subsets.
relocated_pages_note: New page number to baseline page number. The two reference pages keep identical body pixels.
edited_pages_note: Pages whose text was edited. The other changed pages only reflow: page 2 because sections 3, 4, 7 and 8 now start one page later, pages 9, 11, 13-18 and 20-26 after the edits of Sections 1, 2 and 5, and pages 55-57 and 59-61 after the edits of Section 18.
visual_check: All 40 changed pages and the two relocated reference pages rendered at 100 dpi and inspected in contact sheets of four pages; no clipping, overlap, missing text or displaced header or footer was found.
tool: pixcmp.py, a Poppler pdftoppm comparison script; its method is stated above.
